Hi all —

Adding the evaluation plan details so legal and procurement can see acceptance gates clearly. Proposed pilot acceptance criteria (short, testable):

- Functional pass: 95% accuracy on annotated dev set (sample provided)
- Latency SLA: 99th percentile < 450ms for endpoint calls under test load
- Data handling: no persistent storage of PHI; all telemetry goes to customer-owned bucket

Timeline tie-ins: the two-week pilot (Apr 11–Apr 25) will include a mid-point checkpoint (Apr 18) where we share interim metrics and a final acceptance report by Apr 27. If acceptance criteria met, Legal and Procurement can proceed to order-form execution with the usage tiers we discussed.

I'm attaching a lightweight evaluation_checklist.md that maps tests to owners and artifacts. If Helix wants different pass thresholds, flag them this week so we can adjust the MAP.
